note: What the house's hand-written AI code carries, line by line and field by field, as the ids of docs/schemas/kinds/house.json's `ai` slots (S4b-BL-271, docs/03 ADR-36 18.11, docs/ai/ai-design.md 16.8). The house is not read through its slots (its documents, prompts and Plan lines are pinned byte for byte); this file keeps the slots honest. `ask`: the label of each line of an Ask document (the text before the first colon; `Distance to <place>` is `Distance to`) and the slot ids the line carries. `plan`: each field of a Plan candidate and its ids. `extract`: each field of an extracted draft and its ids. `structural` names the fields that carry no value of the house (an id, a coordinate, a distance, the draft's warnings and extras); `noAiOnly` the slot ids that only the no-AI parsers fill (the server's draft has no area). The three stacks' tests (web `house-ai-slots.spec.ts`, server `HouseAiSlotsTest`, phone `HouseAiSlotsTest`) build a house with every field, take the labels and fields their code writes and check: every one is in this file, every id it names is in the slot and none is in `never`, and the slot holds no id that no line or field carries.
